:::{#rem-ppv-prevalence}
#### The PPV depends on the population, not only on the test

The sensitivity and specificity describe the test itself,
but the ratio $\frac{1 - \text{prev}}{\text{prev}}$ in @thm-ppv-sens-spec-prev
describes the population being tested.
When the disease is rare, that ratio is large,
so even a small false positive rate can make the PPV low,
as @exm-ppv-sens-spec-prev shows.

:::
